# Kamal Kumar

> Personal site for Kamal Kumar — cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering. Static content, no tracking, no database.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kamal.sh/): Summary and entry point.
- [Work](https://kamal.sh/work): Case studies and professional experience.
- [Architecture](https://kamal.sh/architecture): An opinionated reference architecture for an enterprise AI platform — gateway, guardrails, governance, evals, cost.
- [Building](https://kamal.sh/building): Products and tools built and maintained.
- [Writing](https://kamal.sh/writing): Blog posts and videos.
- [About](https://kamal.sh/about): Background, education, certifications, live GitHub activity.
- [Testimonials](https://kamal.sh/testimonials): What colleagues and clients have said.
- [Security](https://kamal.sh/security): Security posture of this site, in plain terms.
- [Costs](https://kamal.sh/costs): What this site costs to run, line by line.
- [Postmortems](https://kamal.sh/postmortems): Public, blameless incident writeups.
- [Contact](https://kamal.sh/contact): Contact form and booking.

## Machine-readable

- `curl kamal.sh` (or wget/iwr/any other CLI client): ANSI bold/color résumé, straight from the root domain.
- [resume](https://kamal.sh/resume): Same as the root, ANSI bold/color by default.
- [resume/raw](https://kamal.sh/resume/raw): Plain ASCII, no color codes — for a script or a terminal that can't render them.
- [json](https://kamal.sh/json): Colorized, human-readable résumé data (not valid JSON once colorized — see json/raw).
- [json/raw](https://kamal.sh/json/raw) / [resume.json](https://kamal.sh/resume.json): Actual structured `application/json` résumé data.
- [resume.md](https://kamal.sh/resume.md): Markdown résumé.
- [sitemap.xml](https://kamal.sh/sitemap.xml): Full page index.
- [rss.xml](https://kamal.sh/rss.xml): Writing feed.
